title: 19 Filipino seafarers rescued from drone attack set to return home

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Nineteen Filipino seafarers rescued after their vessel came under an apparent drone attack in the Black Sea are set to return home on Nov. 26, according to the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW). “Sa ngayon, nasa maayos na kalagayan ang mga tripulante, habang patuloy namang nagpapagaling ang dalawang nasugatan matapos malapatan ng kinakailangang lunas sa ospital,” said Labor Attaché Marietta Dela Cruz of Migrant Workers Office (MWO)-Budapest. (The crew members are currently in stable condition, while the two injured seafarers continue to recover after receiving necessary medical treatment at a hospital.)
